restaurantName: Hock Lye Noodles House & Fishii Tales
address: 20 Ghim Moh Road Market & Food Centre, #01-35, Blk 20, Ghim Moh Road, 270020, Singapore
bio: Popular dishes include Hock Lye's noodle soup and dry noodles with meatballs, fish balls, prawns or pork ribs. The hand-made fish balls and fish cakes are springy and flavoursome. Come early, as the meatballs tend to sell out....
